given.note: Google sends Sam back with the state he started and a one-time code. The state is his own (the session's person), so K-16 v1 connectReturn exchanges the code once and keeps the tokens sealed under Sam's key, never in an answer; on registration screen 16 the server then writes S1-24 through K-09 v1 saveSetupStep, called alone for Sam (gives calendar; K-09 v1 setup-s1-24-calendar.json, whose answer this is). The code is a placeholder and is never logged.
